name: Tether — official site
description: Issuer of USDT. Confirm the token's name and that a contract exists for BNB Chain on the issuer's own pages.

name: Circle — USDC contract addresses
description: Circle publishes official USDC contract addresses per chain, including BNB Chain.

name: BscScan — token explorer
description: Search a symbol, open the token page and read the contract marked with a blue verification check. NOTE: BscScan sits behind a bot-protection wall that refuses scripted probes (403) — the CI checker marks it SKIP, not FAIL; verify it once yourself in a real browser.

name: BscScan — contract lookup
description: Paste the address you copied and confirm name, symbol and decimals before adding it here. Also bot-protected against scripted probes (see the note above).

name: CoinGecko
description: Third-party listing: the coin page lists contract addresses per chain. Cross-check, never fully trust.

name: CoinMarketCap
description: Third-party listing: the contracts tab lists community-verified addresses. Cross-check, never fully trust.

name: DefiLlama
description: Open-source aggregator of on-chain tokens — useful as a neutral cross-check point.

name: Trust Wallet asset repository
description: Public community asset files (logos and contract info) used by many wallets; review candidates here.

name: PancakeSwap extended token list
description: Plain-JSON extended list with on-chain-verified entries; the raw file shows contract addresses.
